    About Quandela:

    Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry. Its offerings include the most energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers.
    Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components. Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges.
    Learn more at: Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions

    Our ambition is to build large-scale fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of solving problems beyond the reach of classical computation. 

    Getting there will require several generations of intermediate architectures. Choosing the right ones means understanding what can be built, what these systems can compute and how efficiently they can do so.

    About this position:

    You will join Quandela’s Quantum Information team within Architecture, working on the evaluation and design of our near- and mid-term quantum architectures. 

    Your role will sit between quantum theory, computational capability and real hardware constraints. You will develop methods to evaluate architecture concepts, understand their performance and limitations, and help guide future architecture choices.

    Depending on your background, you may draw on complexity theory, quantum learning theory, quantum-system characterisation, benchmarking or related areas. You will work closely with our Device Physics, FTQC and Q.Algorithms Team.

    Requirements

    What you'll do:

    As a Quantum Information Scientist working on Architecture & Performance, you will: 

    • Evaluate and compare the capabilities and limitations of near- and mid-term quantum architectures. 
    • Draw on methods from complexity theory, benchmarking, characterisation and related fields to assess different architecture designs. 
    • Incorporate realistic noise, native operations and physical constraints into your analyses. 
    • Investigate when and how different architectures could provide meaningful computational capabilities or advantages. 
    • Develop scientific models and numerical tools to explore architecture-performance trade-offs. 
    • Study how architecture choices interact with algorithms, resource requirements and QEC strategies. 
    • Progressively propose and lead new research projects around architecture design and performance. 

    You will work across our Architecture team and Algorithms and Applications team, connecting questions from the physical layer to computational capability and potential applications. 
    -

    How you'll grow:

    During your first 3–6 months 
    Become familiar with Quandela’s technologies, architecture roadmap and ongoing research while contributing to existing evaluation and performance studies. 

    Within 1 year 
    Take increasing ownership of architecture studies, compare different concepts and bring your own scientific perspective to the team. 

    Longer term 
    Lead exploratory research projects, propose new architecture directions and contribute to shaping Quandela’s future architecture roadmap.

    --

    What we're looking for:
    We are looking for a scientist with a strong theoretical background in quantum computing, scientific autonomy and an interest in connecting different layers of the quantum-computing stack.

    Must-have 

    • PhD in Quantum Information, Quantum Computing, Physics, Mathematics, Computer Science or a closely related field. 
    • Strong expertise in one or more relevant areas, such as quantum complexity theory, quantum learning theory, quantum-system characterisation, performance analysis or quantum algorithms. 
    • Experience connecting theoretical or computational questions with realistic implementation, hardware or experimental constraints. 
    • Ability to assess the capabilities and limitations of quantum systems or architectures. 
    • Experience with scientific modelling, numerical simulation and Python-based scientific computing. 
    • Scientific autonomy and ability to structure open-ended research problems.
    • Collaborative and personable, with the ability to communicate ideas clearly to people from other fields of expertise.
    • Professional English. 

    Important, but you can grow here 

    • Quantum Error Correction and early fault-tolerant architectures.
    • Hardware-aware algorithm or architecture design. 
    • Quantum benchmarking and performance metrics. 
    • Noise modelling. 
    • Resource and computational-cost analysis. 
    • Collaboration with experimental or hardware-oriented quantum-computing teams. 

    Bonus 

    • Quantum compilation or native-gate-aware circuit design. 
    • Photonic quantum computing. 
    • Resource estimation. 
    • Experience comparing quantum approaches against strong classical baselines. 
    • Previous ownership of collaborative research projects. 

    You do not need to cover every topic above. We welcome both candidates with postdoctoral or equivalent industrial R&D experience and strong recent PhDs demonstrating scientific autonomy.

    Benefits

    Join a growing quantum-computing company and contribute directly to the research behind future generations of quantum architectures. 

    • Explore open scientific questions grounded in real hardware constraints. 
    • Work across Quantum Information, Device Physics, FTQC and Algorithms. 
    • Take ownership of broad and exploratory research projects. 
    • Contribute to the scientific directions of a growing team. 

    Plus: 

    • Competitive compensation aligned with your experience and level of responsibility. 
    • Company savings plan.
    • 100% health coverage through Alan. 
    • Transport reimbursement or sustainable mobility bonus. 
    • Swile meal vouchers. 
    • Access to Gymlib. 

    Process 

    • Talent Acquisition interview, 30–45 min
    • Interview with Quantum Information hiring manager, 30-45 min
    • Presentation of previous research work and discussion with members of the theory team 
    • Reference checks 
    • Technical discussion based on a scientific paper or research topic
    • Offer 

    For the technical exercise, you may be asked to explore scientific material outside your direct area of expertise and discuss how you would connect it to a broader architecture problem.

    Description

    Legal AI content is turning into a commodity. Every vendor ships the same AI-generated blog posts and the same generic battlecards. We are transitioning into an AI-native company ourselves, and that changes what this role has to be. You would sit in the marketing department with a dotted line to the product department, but not as a traditional product marketer who ships a few blog posts and calls it enablement. Not as a pure thinker who never touches a sales deck. Instead, as one person who owns our voice and turns it into everything the company needs to win: the thesis that gets us cited, the sales slide that closes next week’s deal, and the briefing that gets a General Counsel to say yes.

    You will use AI tooling and agents to cover ground that used to take a small team, so you can spend your own time on the part that cannot be delegated: the thinking, the judgment, and the writing that actually changes someone’s mind.


    Your mission

    1. Product Marketing & Market Intelligence 

    • Drive go-to-market impact for launches and expansion, from plan to execution.

    • Own deep knowledge of our ICP and competitive landscape, and feed it back into the product and sales strategy.

    • Bring market and customer truth back to Product so we build what actually matters.

    • Work across Product, Marketing, Sales and leadership. You don’t sit in a silo.

    2. Positioning, Narrative & Thought Leadership 

    • Own positioning: define what Legartis stands for, against which alternatives, for which buyer.

    • Develop and defend clear, evidence-backed points of view on where Legal AI is going. Not generic AI-created opinions, but real positions based on customer and buyer research (interviews with General Counsel, CFOs, legal operations leaders).

    • Conceive flagship studies and thought leadership content. Direct AI tools to help you scale production while you own the substance and the voice.

    • Own our thought leadership channels, including video, and decide what gets said. Write what can’t be delegated: founder posts, executive bylines, keynote scripts, board-level memos.

    3. Sales & Customer-Facing Enablement 

    • Build the sales slides, briefings, one-pagers and competitive battlecards that make Sales and Customer Success more effective in every conversation.

    • Translate positioning and research into materials for specific deals, verticals and executive-level conversations.

    • Work directly with Sales and CS to find out what’s missing in the field. Build case studies and customer proof points that Sales actually uses, not ones that sit in a folder.

    What We Want to Achieve Together

    In 6 months: a flagship study that gets cited by competitors and customers. Sales armed with materials that actually get used in deals. A clear Legartis position that everyone in the company can repeat in 30 seconds.

    In 12 months: Legartis recognized as one of the leading European voices on Legal AI, with a content and enablement engine, you plus the AI tools you direct, that outproduces companies with five times the headcount.


    Your profile

    • Proven strategist: demonstrated success creating and executing marketing strategies.

    • Storyteller: you craft compelling materials about complex AI products for non-technical audiences.

    • Clear communicator: exceptional written and verbal communication with a strong visual sensibility.

    • Impact-driven: comfortable with experimentation and interpreting both quantitative and qualitative data.

    • AI-savvy: crafty with AI tools and automations — you use them daily and keep exploring what's new.

    • A track record where writing and thinking were central: journalism, industry or analyst research, strategy consulting, or senior product marketing with real strategic ownership. 4+ years in marketing, product marketing or a comparable strategic role at a SaaS company. Classic PMM experience (positioning, GTM, enablement) is a strong plus, not a hard requirement, if your thinking and writing are strong enough.

    • Fluent German and English, executive-level writing in both.


    Why us?

    • Real editorial ownership over our voice and our position, not a content calendar handed down from someone else.

    • A platform to build your own visible profile as a voice in Legal AI.

    • Modern office in Leipzig or Berlin, hybrid setup, with regular presence in Zürich and team events such as hiking, dinners and offsites.

    • Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) participation.

    • Competitive salary, based on experience and seniority.


    Process

    1. 30 min with our People & Operations Manager: cultural fit, understanding the role and your expectations.

    2. Positioning conversation with our Head of Product: bring a point of view on Legal AI and be ready to defend it live.

    3. Case study: show us something you’ve written or built, and how you’d turn it into a sales-ready asset.

    4. Meet the team in the office.

    5. Decision: if it’s mutual, we welcome you to the team!

    How to Apply

    Send us your CV, two or three writing or work samples you’re proud of, and a short note answering: what’s your sharpest point of view on where Legal AI is heading, and what’s the evidence?

    Description

    Legartis is on a mission: to unlock legal work at scale.

    We set the standard for AI-powered contract work by offering a platform that changes how legal teams work, from drafting through negotiation to completion. We are now looking for the person who turns what customers actually need into what our AI actually does.

    Joining Legartis is not taking a job, you take ownership. We are a team of product builders and lawyers, who do not chase hype; we build substance. If you are a lawyer who builds, someone who has stopped waiting for better tools and started making them, this is your moment and your place.

    Send us your CV, a short note on why Legartis, and links to anything you have built or published.


    Your mission

    Most companies split this seat across three teams, and that split is exactly the problem. The person who hears the customer describe their workflow should be the person who writes the requirement, and the person who writes the requirement should be able to build the first version themselves. That is you.

    1. You translate customer reality into engineering requirements — and into revenue. You sit in customer and expert calls alongside Sales, not as a note-taker but as the person who understands the legal work. In trials and hackathons you coach hands-on: the customer drives, you navigate, and they create the first "wow" moment themselves. When they say "that won't work for us" or "we'll build it ourselves", you answer with a concrete path (a workaround, a workflow, the honest maintenance cost of the alternative) and you leave every conversation with a next step: trial licenses, a hackathon, a scoped rollout. Then you pull out the workflow: what actually happens, in what order, where it breaks, what the customer would pay to never do again. And you write the spec, edge cases, and acceptance criteria that Engineering can build against.

    2. You build the skills yourself. You write, test, and ship agent skills and playbooks that solve real customer workflows. You build the evaluation frameworks and test sets that prove they got better rather than just different. When the AI fails on a clause, you diagnose why, at the prompt and context level, and you either fix it or hand Engineering a diagnosis precise enough to act on.

    3. You make it repeatable, and therefore sellable. Anything you build once for one customer, you turn into something Sales and Customer Success can run without you. Standard demo environments. A skill library they can reach for. Onboarding that lands in days rather than months. Where Customer Success needs legal depth you step in, fix it, and turn the fix into something the team can handle alone next time. Your success is measured by how rarely you need to be in the room, and by what happens to adoption and expansion when you are not.

    4. You are the legal authority in the building. Legal and compliance questions land with you: contract reviews, customer security and data protection questions, the occasional in-house matter which makes roughly ten to fifteen percent of your time. You use our own product to do it, and you tell us honestly when it is not good enough.


    Your profile

    The person we picture. There is a name emerging for what we are describing, and it is not "lawyer who is good with computers". It is legal quant: a lawyer who builds their own tooling to practise law, rather than waiting for a vendor to ship it. The distinction that matters to us: plenty of lawyers now use AI. A legal quant builds with it. They look at a workflow and ask how to redesign it from first principles to get the best possible outcome, rather than making the existing process incrementally faster.

    A note on how we are weighting this role. Three capabilities make someone exceptional here: commercial instinct, legal depth, and technical ability to build. The ideal candidate has all three. We know that person is rare, and we are not going to pretend otherwise by writing a wish list and hoping. So for this role we weight the technical evidence most heavily, because it is the hardest of the three to teach on the job.

    If you believe you genuinely combine all three, we want to talk to you regardless of how neatly your CV matches the bullets below. Say so in your note and tell us what you have built and what you have sold.

    1. Technical track record. You have built things and they exist and ideally you have published some of it. You are fluent with LLMs the way a practitioner is fluent, not a spectator: you know how context windows fail you or why a prompt stopped working. When something breaks you go into the system rather than around it. Scripting, Git, and APIs are a strong plus.

    Our Mission

    At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet.     We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

    The Role

    You will build the Command Centre, the screen an operator uses to see what our robots and cameras see, decide in seconds, and task the fleet. Soldiers have already run our console unaided after a short introduction. Next, one operator watches many sites, and tasks robots in plain language instead of drawing routes. That needs an interface built for it.

    This role is engineering and design in one. You will shape the flows, prototype them, test them with operators, and ship them in production code, working with our full-stack engineer on the backend and our vision engineers on what the models show.

    What You'll Work On

    • Operator interface: live video, site maps, robot positions and alerts in one view that works at 03:00.

    • Alert triage: the flow from alert to decision: evidence, context, confirm or dismiss, dispatch a robot.

    • Tasking by instruction: an interface for telling the fleet what to do in plain language, and seeing how it plans to do it.

    • Design system: components and patterns that keep the product consistent as it grows.

    • Usability: prototype, test with operators, measure, iterate.

    • Performance: real-time streams and many sites without the interface slowing down.

    A frontend engineer with real UI/UX craft, who has shipped data-heavy, real-time interfaces that people rely on under pressure.

    • 3+ years of frontend engineering with TypeScript and React.

    • Shipped real-time, data-heavy interfaces: maps, video, dashboards or control panels.

    • UI/UX practice: you design flows, prototype in Figma or similar, and run user tests.

    • Comfortable with backend APIs and real-time transport (WebSockets, WebRTC).

    • Accessibility and performance as habits, not afterthoughts.

    Nice to Have

    • Control room, mission-critical or security interfaces.

    • Mapping and geospatial libraries (Mapbox, deck.gl or similar).

    • Building a design system from scratch.

    • Mission: autonomous security that keeps people and critical sites safe, including in defence.

    We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

    The Role

    You will own the research question at the centre of LEA, our foundation model of the physical world: can a model learn what normally happens on a site, by place, hour and weather, so that an anomaly is simply what it did not expect? The first version is a probabilistic memory of each site. The next is a world model across every site that predicts the next state in latent space, starting from open world-model weights and growing on field data nobody else holds.

    Our robots and cameras run on live security sites around the clock, and every event is kept with its clip, the model's verdict and the operator's outcome. That record is your dataset. You will work alongside our perception and model engineers, and your results go into production, not only into papers.

    What You'll Work On

    • Site memory: a learned, probabilistic model of each site: which people, vehicles and robots are where, at what hour, in what weather, and how the scene usually unfolds.

    • Anomaly as surprise: replace rule-based alerting with measured surprise, and work out how to evaluate it when real incidents are rare.

    • World model: post-train open world-model weights on aligned multi-sensor field sequences, JEPA-style, predicting in latent space rather than pixels.

    • Transfer: from one site's memory to a model of all of them, and representations that carry across sites and domains.

    • Research direction: choose the questions, design the experiments, and decide what is true before it ships.

    Who We're Looking For

    A research scientist who has led work on world models, self-supervised learning or probabilistic spatio-temporal modelling, and who wants to see it run on real sites. You are rigorous about what a result does and does not show, and pragmatic about getting it into a product.

    Your Background

    • PhD in machine learning, computer vision, robotics or a related field, with first-author publications at top venues.

    • Research experience in world models, video or latent prediction, self-supervised representation learning, or probabilistic modelling of spatio-temporal data.

    • Experience with anomaly or novelty detection where positives are rare.

    • Strong PyTorch and the engineering to run your own experiments at scale.

    Nice to Have

    • Scene graphs, multi-object tracking or trajectory forecasting.

    • Bayesian or probabilistic deep learning.

    • Robotics or embodied AI.

    • Simulation for data generation.

    You will own the path a code change takes from commit to robot, and the evidence behind every gate on that path. Today the honest answer to "is this build safe?" is "it worked on the test robot." You will replace that with a system: the simulation environment the team tests against, the regression suites that run on every change, the hardware-in-the-loop rigs, and the release gates that decide whether a build can go onto a robot that will patrol a customer site alone tonight.

    This is the first engineer dedicated to reliability and test infrastructure, and it sits in our Robot Autonomy team, next to the engineers building perception, localisation, planning and locomotion. Our robots patrol security sites, critical infrastructure and defence facilities without a human present, so a bad release is not a rollback: it is a customer incident. Within six months, nothing should reach a customer robot without passing something you built.

    • Release pipeline: code change, automated tests, simulation at scale, staging robot, pilot site, full rollout, with explicit pass criteria at every gate and nothing advancing without meeting them.

    • Scenario libraries and regression suites: coverage across the whole on-robot stack, perception through locomotion, and the infrastructure to run thousands of scenarios on every change.

    • Hardware-in-the-loop: bench rigs and test procedures on the physical robots for what simulation cannot tell you.

    • Failure injection: drop sensors, degrade LiDAR returns, kill the network link, corrupt odometry, then verify the system degrades and recovers the way we tell customers it does.

    • Field incidents to tests: when a robot misbehaves on site, reproduce it deterministically and turn it into a permanent regression test.

    • Reproducibility: log capture, replay tooling, deterministic seeds, versioned scenarios, and coverage metrics that are honest about what they do not cover.

Location Designation: Fully Remote

Business Unit Overview

Group Benefit Solutions delivers comprehensive insurance and absence management solutions for mid-size and large companies. Our work fosters a healthier, happier and more secure workforce, contributing to New York Life’s legacy of being there when we’re needed most. Here, you’ll design, implement and support these solutions directly impacting customers’ lives. At our core, we provide financial security and peace of mind to people through our absence, accident, disability, voluntary benefits and life insurance solutions.

Role Overview

The Nurse Case Manager is a licensed Registered Nurse who serves as a clinical consultant, partnering with Claim Managers to provide specialized clinical expertise in the evaluation of Short-Term Disability (STD) and Long-Term Disability (LTD) claims. Leveraging expertise in medical and behavioral health conditions, the Nurse Case Manager conducts comprehensive reviews of clinical documentation, evaluates the severity and functional impact of reported conditions, and assesses whether the available medical evidence supports the identified functional restrictions or demonstrates functional impairment. The role collaborates with claims professionals, treating providers, internal physician consultants, and other clinical/vocational resources to support thorough, consistent, and timely claim evaluations while maintaining a holistic, function-focused approach.

What You’ll Do

  • Conduct comprehensive clinical reviews of STD and LTD claims involving medical, surgical, behavioral health, and co-occurring conditions. Integrate information from treating providers, customers, questionnaires, and other relevant sources to assess condition severity, functional impact, treatment response, expected recovery, comorbidities, and whether the available evidence supports identified restrictions and limitations or demonstrates functional impairment.
  • Identify inconsistencies, gaps in clinical information, and areas requiring further clarification; formulate focused clinical questions; and recommend appropriate next steps, including requests for additional clinical information or records, provider or customer outreach, and physician or specialty review when warranted.
  • Provide clear, objective, and well-supported clinical recommendations that support claim evaluation, assessment of functional status, and return-to-work considerations.
  • Serve as a clinical resource by educating and consulting with Claim Managers while fostering collaborative relationships with internal business partners, physician consultants, and external healthcare providers.
  • Document clinical findings, recommendations, and rationale in accordance with departmental standards, applicable policies, and regulatory requirements.
  • Participate in quality assurance initiatives, departmental projects, training, and continuous process improvement activities.

What You’ll Bring

Required

  • Current, unrestricted Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of residence and, where applicable, the state of employment.
  • Three to five years of clinical nursing experience, including demonstrated experience in behavioral health.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of medical and behavioral health diagnoses, treatment modalities, psychopharmacology, and recovery principles.
  • Experience reviewing and analyzing medical records, behavioral health documentation, diagnostic findings, treatment plans, and other clinical information relevant to functional assessment.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, electronic documentation systems, and other technology platforms used to support clinical review and case management.

Preferred

  • Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN).
  • Experience in disability insurance, disability case management, utilization management, managed care, or workers' compensation.
  • Experience supporting medical and behavioral health disability claims within Short-Term Disability (STD), Long-Term Disability (LTD), or both.
  • Knowledge of evidence-based disability management and return-to-work principles.

Skills and Competencies

  • Strong clinical judgment, critical thinking, and analytical skills, with the ability to synthesize complex clinical information and evaluate its impact on function.
  • Strong written and verbal communication and consultation skills, with the ability to convey complex clinical information clearly to clinical and non-clinical audiences.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with Claim Managers, healthcare providers, and multidisciplinary partners.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, communicate effectively during real-time interactions, document concurrently, and navigate multiple systems in a fast-paced environment.
  • Continuous improvement mindset, with the ability to identify opportunities to enhance clinical review processes, quality, consistency, and efficiency.
  • Digital fluency and adaptability, including the ability to effectively use and adopt emerging technologies and AI-enabled tools in accordance with organizational policies and standards.
  • Commitment to continuous learning and professional development.

Pay Transparency

Salary Range: $89,000-$115,000

Overtime eligible: Exempt

Discretionary bonus eligible: Yes

Sales bonus eligible: No

Actual base salary will be determined based on several factors but not limited to individual’s experience, skills, qualifications, and job location. Location:LATAM remote. Open to other timezones with overlap to UTC-3 / UTC-5.

Reports to: Engineering Manager, Core Platform


About Playbypoint

We're a rapidly expanding startup at the forefront of the racquet sports industry. At Playbypoint, we specialize in providing innovative enterprise software solutions that empower clubs, players, and coaches to streamline their operations and enhance their game. We're backed by top investors, trusted by leading clubs, and scaling fast – and we're looking for passionate individuals to join us in revolutionizing the racquet sports world with cutting-edge software.

The Role

We're building the platform that lets the world build on top of Playbypoint — and we're looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to be part of it. This goes beyond a traditional external API: you'll design and deliver the full stack of surfaces that enable developers, partners, and AI agents to integrate with us — REST APIs, MCP servers, skills, webhooks, and the developer experience layer that ties it all together.

This is a high-visibility, high-ownership role at the intersection of platform engineering and the emerging ecosystem of AI-powered builders.

Our stack: Ruby on Rails (backend), React + TypeScript (frontend), GraphQL and REST APIs, MySQL / Redis / Sidekiq, cloud-native infrastructure on AWS.

What You'll Do

  • Design and build Playbypoint's external API — versioned, stable, and built to scale with a growing ecosystem of integrators and partners.

  • Develop and maintain MCP servers and skills that expose Playbypoint capabilities to AI agents and developer tools.

  • Own the developer experience end to end: API documentation, developer portal, onboarding flows, SDKs, and sandbox environments.

  • Define API governance practices: versioning strategy, deprecation policies, backward compatibility, and breaking change management.

  • Build the infrastructure that makes our external surfaces observable and reliable — rate limiting, auth, throttling, usage analytics.

  • Partner with product and internal engineering teams to expose platform capabilities through well-designed, consistent integration contracts.

  • Track and shape how the ecosystem of builders — human and AI — integrates with Playbypoint.

You Might Thrive in This Role If You

  • Have 7+ years of software engineering experience, with significant focus on API design, platform development, or developer tooling.

  • Are comfortable across the full stack — backend API design and frontend developer portal/documentation surfaces.

  • Have designed and shipped public or partner-facing APIs at scale — versioning, auth models, rate limiting, and the full lifecycle of an external API are familiar territory.

  • Have hands-on experience building for AI-era integration surfaces — MCP servers, agent skills, LLM tool definitions, or similar patterns.

  • Care deeply about developer experience: you've built or contributed to developer portals, SDKs, or documentation systems that builders actually love.

  • Understand the difference between an internal API and an external one — backward compatibility, contract stability, and the cost of breaking changes are not abstract concepts.

  • Are comfortable working across teams to define integration contracts that balance internal velocity with external stability.

  • Communicate clearly and default to async. Strong written and spoken English is a must — we work closely with US-based stakeholders and partners, and our developer-facing surfaces are products in themselves.

Engineering in the AI Era

We expect every engineer at Playbypoint to work with AI as a core part of their craft — not as a novelty, but as a force multiplier across the entire SDLC. That means:

  • Actively using AI tools throughout the development lifecycle — design, coding, code review, testing, debugging, and incident analysis.

  • Having built AI-powered tooling or agents — whether internal automation, LLM-integrated features, or workflow improvements that shipped to production.

  • Knowing when AI adds real value and when it doesn't — judgment matters more than enthusiasm.

We don't expect everyone to be an AI researcher. We do expect you to be fluent in the tools and patterns of the moment, and curious about what's next.

Bonus

  • Experience building API gateways, developer portals, or API management platforms.

  • Deep familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol), agent skill frameworks, or AI-native integration patterns.

  • Background in vertical SaaS, marketplaces, or fintech — where API reliability directly impacts partner revenue.

  • Familiarity with OpenAPI/Swagger, webhook infrastructure, or event-driven integration patterns.

  • Experience with Ruby on Rails at scale.

Help transform how Finance teams work by building AI-powered tools that give analysts valuable time back. Your work will help finance professionals focus on higher-value analysis and decision-making.


This is an opportunity for someone who combines finance expertise with software engineering skills and enjoys solving complex business challenges through modern data and AI technologies.

  • Build AI-assisted variance commentary and close-checklist solutions that generate draft insights from financial data and identify key business drivers.
  • Develop experiences using Databricks Genie and governed finance data to enable analysts to explore information through natural language.

  • Design and deliver AI-enabled applications using Databricks, Python, and modern LLM technologies.
  • Ensure solutions align with governance requirements by maintaining clear separation between AI-generated recommendations and financial control activities.
  • Collaborate with finance stakeholders to understand processes, close cycles, planning activities, and reporting needs.

What You'll Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience with Databricks and building data-driven solutions.
  • 2+ years of LLM application engineering experience, including prompt engineering, context engineering, retrieval, structured outputs, and evaluation.
  • 2+ years of experience using Python and sufficient full-stack development skills to deliver production-ready applications.
  • 2+ years of experience working within or closely alongside Finance teams, with knowledge of FP&A processes, monthly close activities, budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and revenue recognition fundamentals.
  • Experience working with finance systems and governed financial data, including platforms such as NetSuite, Certinia, and Workday Adaptive Planning.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft 365 and Copilot, MLflow, Databricks Vector Search, Databricks Genie, Genie Code, and/or GenieOne; CRO or pharma-services experience and SOX exposure are preferred.
  • Proficiency in English

This role serves as the business and relationship lead for assigned supplier partners, driving profitable growth and performance against annual operating plan (AOP) objectives. The Senior Portfolio Manager will manage supplier relationships, lead business reviews and commercial negotiations, identify growth opportunities, and develop and execute portfolio and supplier strategies.


The ideal candidate brings clinical diagnostics experience, strong commercial judgment and executive presence, and the ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution while managing multiple priorities. Experience with capital instrumentation is strongly preferred.

  • Own the business relationship for assigned supplier partners, driving alignment, performance, and profitable growth.

  • Lead supplier business reviews, including performance analysis, business updates, opportunities, risks, and action plans.
  • Negotiate commercial terms with suppliers, including pricing, rebates, and marketing funding; partner with Legal and other stakeholders on contractual agreements.
  • Build strong, collaborative supplier relationships while effectively managing negotiations, aligning priorities, and driving shared business objectives.

  • Analyze market dynamics, business performance, pricing, margin, and forecasts to develop business cases and inform portfolio decisions.
  • Develop pricing and positioning strategies that support profitable growth.
  • Partner across Sales, Finance, Supply Chain, Capital Contracting, Purchasing, Marketing, Quality, Regulatory, Legal, Product Administration, Learning and Development, and other Thermo Fisher Scientific teams to achieve business objectives.
  • Secure supplier support and funding for strategic sales, marketing, training, and commercial programs.
  • Take ownership of business issues, engage the appropriate stakeholders, and drive timely resolution.
  • Effectively prioritize and manage multiple suppliers, projects, deadlines, and business needs while maintaining focus on longer-term objectives.

You'll own the full sales cycle for named major accounts, from initial engagement through close, working closely with CISOs, CSO, heads of corporate security, executive protection teams, and HR leadership to position BlackCloak as a critical, non-negotiable layer of executive risk management.

What You Need to be Successful

    You communicate credibly with C-suite and board-adjacent stakeholders, you know how to run a structured, multi-threaded enterprise sales process, and you're comfortable with a consultative, education-led sales motion.

    Experience selling into physical security, corporate investigations, or executive protection ecosystems is a plus, as is existing familiarity with data privacy, identity protection, or personal cybersecurity markets.

      <title>Glean: Application Security Engineer</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> United States, Remote
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><div><span><strong>About Glean:</strong></span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles.</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level.</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality.</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more - deeply embedded where people get things done. You’ll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company.</span></div></div><p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span><strong>About the Role:</strong></span></p>
<p><span>Glean is looking for an experienced <strong>Application Security Engineer</strong> with a primary focus on ensuring that our entire technology stack is free of software vulnerabilities (CVEs). This role is responsible for securing our base OS images, ensuring all open-source software (OSS) dependencies are scanned and patched, and integrating cutting-edge security tools into our CI/CD pipeline. The ideal candidate will drive the adoption of solutions like Google’s Assured Open Source Software (OSS) and explore alternative approaches to enhance software security. This role will lead the vulnerability management charter at Glean, identifying, evaluating, and implementing new security technologies and processes to proactively protect our infrastructure.</span></p>
<h3><span><strong>You will:</strong></span></h3>
<ul>
<li class="wnfdnte _1ibi0s33w"><span>Own the vulnerability management lifecycle across Glean’s technology stack, from discovery and prioritization through remediation, reporting, and measurement.</span></li>
<li class="wnfdnte _1ibi0s33w">
<div class="wnfdntu _1ibi0s3f5 _1ibi0s3ce _1ibi0s3ea"><span>Harden base OS images and secure open-source dependencies, package managers, and the broader software supply chain.</span></div>
</li>
<li class="wnfdnte _1ibi0s33w">
<div class="wnfdntu _1ibi0s3f5 _1ibi0s3ce _1ibi0s3ea"><span>Integrate SAST, DAST, dependency scanning, and automated security validation into CI/CD pipelines.</span></div>
</li>
<li class="wnfdnte _1ibi0s33w">
<div class="wnfdntu _1ibi0s3f5 _1ibi0s3ce _1ibi0s3ea"><span>Evaluate, adopt, and develop security solutions and tooling, including Google’s Assured OSS and comparable approaches.</span></div>
</li>
<li class="wnfdnte _1ibi0s33w">
<div class="wnfdntu _1ibi0s3f5 _1ibi0s3ce _1ibi0s3ea"><span>Define secure-coding practices and drive engineering adoption through guidance, training, and mentorship.</span></div>
</li>
</ul>
<h3><span><strong>About you:</strong></span></h3>
<ul>
<li><span>BA/BS in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field (or equivalent industry experience).</span></li>
<li><span>8+ years of experience in application security and vulnerability management.</span></li>
<li><span>Deep understanding of software security vulnerabilities, including CVEs, OWASP Top 10, and supply chain risks.</span></li>
<li><span>Experience with SAST, DAST, dependency scanning, and vulnerability management tools (e.g., Snyk, GitHub Dependabot, Trivy, Clair, Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP).</span>&nbsp;</li>
<li><span>Hands-on experience with cloud-native security across AWS, GCP, including containers, Kubernetes, and microservices.</span></li>
<li><span>Ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and drive security adoption across engineering teams.</span></li>
<li><span>Proactive, pragmatic, and collaborative, with strong problem-solving skills and the ability to balance security with performance and usability.</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span><strong>Location:&nbsp;</strong></span></p>
<ul>
<li><span>This role is remote</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span><strong>Compensation &amp; Benefits:</strong></span></p>
<p><span>The standard base salary range for this position is $185,000 - $260,000 annually. Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.</span></p>
<div><span>We offer a comprehensive benefits package including competitive compensation, Medical, Vision, and Dental coverage, generous time-off policy, and the opportunity to contribute to your 401k plan to support your long-term goals. When you join, you'll receive a home office improvement stipend, as well as an annual education and wellness stipends to support your growth and wellbeing. We foster a vibrant company culture through regular events, and provide healthy lunches daily to keep you fueled and focused.</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>We’re committed to building and sustaining a diverse, inclusive workplace. We strive to attract and retain people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we do not discriminate on the basis of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race.<span class="screenreader-hidden-offscreen">&nbsp;</span></span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>#LI-REMOTE</span></div><div class="content-conclusion"><div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span><strong>AI-First Mindset at Glean:</strong></span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. <strong>As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role. </strong>Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today — prior Glean experience isn't required.</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span><strong>Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants:</strong></span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), or other privacy laws may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. Our full notice outlining how data will be processed as part of the application procedure for applicable locations is available in our <a href="https://www.glean.com/privacy"><strong>Privacy Policy</strong></a>. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. US applicants and their applications are subject to arbitration of disputes as outlined in our <a href="https://www.glean.com/arbitrationagreement"><strong>Applicant Arbitration Agreement</strong></a>.</span></div>
<div><span><br>By clicking “Submit Application,” I confirm that I have read the Global Data Privacy Notice and the <a href="https://www.glean.com/arbitrationagreement"><strong>Applicant Arbitration Agreement</strong></a>, and I agree to the terms.&nbsp;&nbsp;</span></div></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/glean-application-security-engineer">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/glean-application-security-engineer</a></p>
</description>

      <title>Adventure Travel 365: Senior Full-Stack Developer - Marketplace Web & Mobile Platform</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0076/3373/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Phoenix, Arizona
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://adventuretravel365.com/">https://adventuretravel365.com/</a>
</p>

<h2>Senior Full-Stack Developer - Marketplace Web &amp; Mobile Platform</h2>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">We have a big idea, and we’re looking for a <strong>top-notch Senior Full-Stack Developer</strong> to help us bring it to life.</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">We’re building a new contractor referral and services marketplace, think <strong>Thumbtack or Angi</strong>, where clients can easily find and connect with contractors and service providers. The vision includes both an interactive web platform and mobile app, with everything from user accounts and referrals to job tracking, payments, advertising, and more.</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd"><strong>This is a fully remote, full-time, ongoing position, and we’re open to applicants worldwide.</strong></p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">There are a lot of moving pieces, which is exactly why we’re looking for someone who has built something like this before and gets excited about taking a platform from an idea to a working product, then continuing to grow it with us.</p>
<h2>What You’ll Help Us Build</h2>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">The platform will have two main sides: <strong>clients looking for services and contractors/vendors looking for business.</strong></p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">Some of the functionality we’re planning includes:</p>
<ul>
<li>Client and contractor/vendor accounts and profiles</li>
<li>Contractor listings, categories, search, and filtering</li>
<li>Service requests, inquiries, referrals, and lead management</li>
<li>Job and project tracking</li>
<li>Client and vendor dashboards</li>
<li>Online payments and transaction tracking</li>
<li>Reviews and ratings</li>
<li>Notifications and communications</li>
<li>Banner advertising and paid promotional opportunities</li>
<li>Admin tools for managing the platform</li>
<li>Reporting and analytics</li>
<li>Secure management of user, job, and transaction data</li>
</ul>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">And probably more! We have a strong vision for where we want this to go, but we also want the right developer to help us determine the smartest way to build it.</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">This will be an evolving platform, so we’re looking for someone who wants to <strong>grow with it, not simply complete a checklist of features.</strong></p>
<h2>Who We’re Looking For</h2>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">We’d love to find someone with strong experience in <strong>full-stack web and mobile development</strong>, especially someone who has worked on a marketplace, booking platform, service-provider network, or another multi-user platform.</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">You should be comfortable with:</p>
<ul>
<li>Full-stack web development</li>
<li>Mobile or cross-platform app development</li>
<li>Strong front-end <strong>and</strong> back-end development</li>
<li>Multi-user marketplace platforms</li>
<li>User authentication and account management</li>
<li>Payment gateway integrations</li>
<li>Databases and APIs</li>
<li>Third-party integrations</li>
<li>Dashboards and reporting</li>
<li>Secure, scalable application architecture</li>
<li>Cloud hosting and deployment</li>
<li>Testing, maintenance, and optimization</li>
<li>Using modern <strong>AI-powered development tools</strong> and integrating AI capabilities into web and mobile applications</li>
</ul>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">If you’ve worked on something similar to <strong>Thumbtack, Angi, TaskRabbit, Upwork, or another two-sided marketplace</strong>, we definitely want to hear about it.</p>
<h2>More Than Just Coding</h2>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">We’re not looking for someone who simply waits for a list of instructions and starts coding.</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">We want someone who can look at the big picture, ask the right questions, recommend the best technical approach, flag potential challenges, and help turn our ideas into a platform that’s intuitive, scalable, and built to grow.</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">You’ll also be expected to <strong>study established platforms like Thumbtack and Angi</strong>, understand how their user journeys and marketplace functionality work from both the client and service-provider sides, and use those learnings to help us determine the best approach for our own platform.</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">You should be able to take the project through <strong>planning, architecture, development, testing, launch, and beyond</strong>, while communicating clearly with a non-technical team along the way.</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd"><strong>Strong spoken and written English communication skills are important.</strong> You should be comfortable discussing ideas, explaining technical decisions clearly, and communicating regularly with a non-technical team.</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">This is <strong>not a short-term build-and-leave project.</strong> We’re looking for someone who can stay with the platform as it grows, helping us continually improve, expand, and maintain it over time.</p>
<h2>Interested? Tell Us About Yourself</h2>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">Please send us:</p>
<ul>
<li>A quick introduction</li>
<li>Your resume or LinkedIn profile</li>
<li>Your portfolio and links to websites/apps you’ve built</li>
<li>Examples of marketplaces, booking platforms, referral systems, or payment-enabled platforms you’ve worked on</li>
<li>What <strong>you personally worked on</strong> for those projects</li>
<li>Your experience using AI in development</li>
<li>What technologies/frameworks you’d recommend for a project like this and why</li>
<li>Your availability</li>
</ul>
<p class="isSelectedEnd"><strong>A short video introduction would be great, too!</strong> Nothing overly formal, just a quick introduction so we can get to know you, hear about your experience, and get a feel for how you communicate.</p>
<p>Most importantly, <strong>show us what you’ve built.</strong> If you’ve helped create a multi-sided marketplace similar to Thumbtack or Angi, tell us about it. We’d love to see it.</p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/adventure-travel-365-senior-full-stack-developer-marketplace-web-mobile-platform">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/adventure-travel-365-senior-full-stack-developer-marketplace-web-mobile-platform</a></p>
</description>

      <title>Hex Technologies: Cloud Security Engineer</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> SF, NYC, or Remote (US)
</p>

<h3>About the role</h3>
<p>We are looking for an experienced Cloud Security Engineer to join Hex’s security team. You will be responsible for ensuring the security and resilience of our cloud infrastructure, providing leadership in cloud security practices, and collaborating closely with our infrastructure and engineering teams to secure our cloud-native applications.</p>
<hr>
<h3>About the role:</h3>
<ul>
<li>Design, implement, and manage security solutions and controls for AWS environments and Kubernetes clusters, including appropriate isolation/sandboxing methods for Hex’s RCE-as-a-Service platform</li>
<li>Build, deploy, and maintain infrastructure-as-code using Terraform, ensuring robust security standards are enforced.</li>
<li>Conduct security assessments, threat modeling, and audits on AWS cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes deployments.</li>
<li>Collaborate with development and operations teams to embed security best practices into CI/CD pipelines.</li>
<li>Monitor and respond to cloud security incidents, identifying root causes and recommending remediation actions.</li>
<li>Provide expertise in compliance requirements related to cloud security (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI DSS).</li>
<li>Mentor engineers and advocate for cloud security across the organization.</li>
</ul>
<h3>About you:&nbsp;</h3>
<ul>
<li>5+ years of experience in cloud security engineering, with extensive expertise in AWS.</li>
<li>Demonstrated proficiency with Kubernetes security including cluster hardening, role-based access control (RBAC), network policies, and container vulnerability management.</li>
<li>Expert-level knowledge and hands-on experience with Terraform.</li>
<li>Familiarity with AWS security services (e.g., IAM, GuardDuty, Security Hub, CloudTrail, WAF).</li>
<li>Familiarity with CNAPP solutions such as Wiz</li>
<li>Familiarity with SIEM solutions such as Panther</li>
<li>Solid understanding of secure software development lifecycle practices, CI/CD security, and DevSecOps methodologies.</li>
<li>Relevant certifications such as AWS Certified Security – Specialty, Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist (CKS), and Terraform Associate certification are highly desirable.</li>
<li>Bonus points for security certifications from SANS or OffSec.</li>
<li>Excellent problem-solving, communication, and leadership skills.</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h3>Our Engineering team</h3>
<p>We’re a group of engineers who are forging new ground together and love partnering with Security on our journey to pull ahead of our competition. You can read about how we think through problems as well as how we learn from mistakes on our blog here:</p>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://hex.tech/blog/we-took-down-production/">How we took down production…</a></li>
<li><a href="https://hex.tech/blog/beyond-linear-notebooks/">Beyond Linear Notebooks</a></li>
<li><a href="https://hex.tech/blog/a-pragmatic-approach-to-live-collaboration/">A pragmatic approach to live collaboration</a></li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h3 class="Heading__HeadingInternal-sc-sir940-0 Heading___StyledHeadingInternal-sc-sir940-1 eQrUa-d">Our stack</h3>
<p>Our product is a web-based notebook and app authoring platform. Our frontend is built with Typescript and React, using a combination of Apollo GraphQL and Redux for managing application state and data. On the backend, we also use Typescript to power an Express/Apollo GraphQL server that interacts with Postgres, Redis, and Kubernetes to manage our database and Python kernels. Our backend is tightly integrated with our infrastructure and CI/CD, where we use a combination of Terraform, Helm, and AWS to deploy and maintain our stack.</p>
<hr>
<p>In addition to our unique culture, Hex proudly offers a competitive total rewards package, including but not limited to, market-benched salary &amp; equity, comprehensive health benefits, and flexible paid time off.</p>
<p>The salary range for this role is: $198,750 - $295,000</p>
<p>The salary range shown may be a reflection of additional factors such as geographical location and skill ranges/levels we’re open to. Placement in the salary range will be decided upon completion of the interview process, taking into account factors like leaving room for growth, internal fairness &amp; parity, your demonstrated skills, and the depth of your experience. Our Recruiting team will be able to provide more details during the interview process.</p>

to develop and maintain accurate data mappings between systems.</li><li>Debug and resolve production integration failures independently, including root-cause analysis and preventative improvements.</li><li>Instrument integration pipelines with appropriate monitoring, logging, and alerting.</li><li>Support Marketing Portfolio transition integrations while avoiding unnecessary point-to-point dependencies and new integration debt.</li><li>Use AI tools to accelerate mapping drafts, API stubs, test generation, documentation, and error-handling boilerplate.</li><li>Review and harden AI-generated output to ensure it meets production standards for reliability, maintainability, and quality.</li><li>Automate replay, retry, alerting, and recovery runbooks to reduce mean time to recovery (MTTR).</li><li>Continuously improve the reliability, observability, and operational efficiency of the integrations you own.</li></ul><p><strong>Required experience</strong></p><ul><li>5+ years of integration engineering experience.</li><li>Hands-on experience with MuleSoft or an equivalent enterprise ESB/API integration platform.</li><li>Experience integrating with SAP, including IDoc, API, and/or BAPI patterns.</li><li>Experience with Salesforce integrations and enterprise API patterns.</li><li>Experience with data lake ingestion and integration patterns.</li><li>Strong understanding of API contracts, data mapping, transformations, testing, and integration architecture.</li><li>Demonstrated experience supporting integrations in production, including monitoring, troubleshooting, alerting, retry/replay, and incident resolution.</li><li>Ability to take ownership of production issues and drive them through diagnosis, recovery, and prevention, rather than simply handing them off to another team.</li><li>Experience using AI copilots or agents to accelerate software engineering workflows.</li><li>Strong engineering judgment and the ability to validate, test, and improve AI-generated code and artifacts before they reach production.</li></ul>

      <title>Collibra: CPS Account Program Manager</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote, USA
</p>

<h3><strong>Joining Collibra’s CPS Account Program Manager team</strong></h3>
<p>The Account Program Manager (APM) serves as the strategic partner and relationship manager for Collibra Public Sector’s Federal customers. This role is integral to ensuring customer satisfaction, driving adoption, and delivering value from Collibra’s solutions while collaborating closely with our Services and other GTM teams to create a seamless and resilient customer journey. This role directly influences retention, advocacy, and long-term account success.</p>
<p>In this role, you will bridge the gap between customer mission needs and our software solutions, coordinating the technical team towards delivering successful implementation, adoption, and value. The APMs primary responsibility is to partner closely with sales, services, support, customer engineering, and product teams to proactively safeguard account health, revenue, and customer satisfaction, by proactively identifying and mitigating risk, preventing and managing escalations, and assessing customer health.&nbsp;</p>
<h3><strong>Account Program Managers at Collibra Public Sector are responsible for</strong></h3>
<p><strong>Relationship building and management</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned federal accounts, building trusted relationships with key stakeholders, system integrators and partners.</li>
<li>Establish long-term relationships within assigned government customers while developing an understanding of the client’s strategic goals and overall impact on business results.</li>
<li>Understand customers' business objectives, technical needs, and success criteria, aligning Collibra’s services to meet their goals.</li>
<li>Support renewals and expansion by demonstrating technical value and best practices.</li>
<li>Understand customer mission objectives and map them to product capabilities.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Advocacy and operational readiness</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Provide guidance during onboarding, deployment, upgrades, and ongoing operations.</li>
<li>Coordinate technical discussions, architecture reviews, and solution design sessions.</li>
<li>Assist with documentation, technical presentations, and briefings for government stakeholders.</li>
<li>Coordinate product functionality and roadmap meetings between product customers and the customer.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Planning and project management</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Coordinate Support, Services and Customer Engineering on customer projects and initiatives by providing project leadership and guidance based on customer overall objectives.</li>
<li>Align services delivery with customer’s business needs by ensuring successful project execution and implementations are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned to customer goals.</li>
<li>Drive customer alignment on goals, success criteria, and acceptance milestones.</li>
<li>Track project progress and provide regular status updates to customers and internal leadership.</li>
<li>Understand the customer’s high-level business challenges while functioning as an advisory resource for “Best Practices” in driving adoption of Collibra’s solutions.</li>
<li>Manage scope, risks, issues, and dependencies across multiple concurrent projects.</li>
<li>Deliver reports for customers as required based on business objectives.&nbsp;</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Health assessment and risk prevention</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Identify and track key customer risk indicators (usage, sentiment, support volume, executive engagement, compliance).</li>
<li>Lead the effort with Sales and the technical teams to identify customer risk, performance issues, and opportunities for optimization.</li>
<li>Help customers avoid and/or mitigate issues with proactive guidance based on extensive customer experience.</li>
<li>Advocate for customer needs internally, influencing product roadmap and prioritization.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Escalation prevention and management</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Act as point of contact for managing escalations, coordinating cross-functional resolution with Support, Product, and Engineering.</li>
<li>Provide clear and constructive product feedback to Collibra’s Product Management teams based on customer use-cases and requirements.</li>
<li>Be a customer advocate to ensure that escalations are resolved in a timely fashion.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>You have</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>5+ years of experience in a technical customer-facing role (TAM, Solutions Engineer, Systems Engineer, or similar)</li>
<li>Experience supporting U.S. federal government customers (civilian, DoD, or IC)</li>
<li>Strong understanding of enterprise software, SaaS, or cloud-based solutions</li>
<li>Ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences</li>
<li>Experience working in regulated or high-security environments</li>
<li>Excellent communication, organization, and stakeholder management skills</li>
<li>Experience deploying enterprise solutions</li>
<li>Knowledge of government hierarchy and operations</li>
<li>Strong business insight and problem-solving skills with the ability to influence internal and external stakeholders at all levels</li>
<li>Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as FedRAMP, NIST 800-53</li>
<li>Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), especially GovCloud or equivalent</li>
<li>Experience working with system integrators</li>
<li>Knowledge of government hierarchy and operations</li>
<li>A solid technical background in data management</li>
<li>Active or eligible U.S. Government security clearance</li>
<li>Because this role supports the U.S. government business, it is required that this candidate be a U.S. citizen who resides on U.S. soil</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>You are</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Exceptional in communication, presentation and interpersonal skills including the ability to communicate effectively and build relationships within government entities</li>
<li>Fast learner with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to a variety of audiences</li>
<li>Excellent in communication, organization, and stakeholder management skills</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Measures of success</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Within the first 30 days</li>
<ul>
<li>Understand your customers objectives and ongoing efforts</li>
<li>Identify account risks and project blockers</li>
<li>Attend account team meetings for assigned accounts</li>
</ul>
<li>Within the first 60 days</li>
<ul>
<li>Develop a Success Plan for each assigned customer based on their objectives and ongoing efforts</li>
<li>Develop a remediation plan for customers at risk collaborating with the sales and technical teams</li>
<li>Participate in account team meetings for assigned accounts</li>
<li>Identify key customer contacts at all levels</li>
</ul>
<li>Within the first 90 days</li>
<ul>
<li>Begin to execute the Success Plan for each assigned customer</li>
<li>Begin to execute the remediation plan for customers at risk collaborating with the sales and technical teams</li>
<li>Lead account team meetings for assigned accounts</li>
<li>Begin to develop a relationship with key customer contacts at all levels</li>
</ul>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Compensation for this role</strong></h3>
<p>The standard base salary range for this position is $104,000 - $130,000 per year. This position is not eligible for additional commission-based compensation. Salary offers are based on a combination of factors, including, but not limited to, experience, skills, and location.</p>
<p>In addition to base salary, we offer a competitive total rewards package, including bonus potential, equity for eligible roles, a Flex Fund monthly stipend, pension/401k plans, and more.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>Benefits at Collibra</h3>
<p>Collibra recognizes and values that everyone has different needs, interests, and life goals. We built our benefits program with flexibility in mind to support you and your loved ones through a diverse range of circumstances and life events. These flexible offerings sit on a foundation of competitive compensation, health coverage, and time off. Learn more about <a href="https://www.collibra.com/us/en/company/careers/benefits">Collibra’s benefits</a>.</p>
<p>We create inclusion and belonging through how we onboard, meet, connect, engage, and communicate. Learn more about&nbsp;<a href="https://www.collibra.com/us/en/company/careers/dei">diversity, equity, and inclusion</a> at Collibra.</p>
<p>At Collibra, we’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We realize the key to creating a company with a world-class culture and employee experience comes from who we hire and creating a workplace that celebrates everyone.</p>
<p>With this, we proudly consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, pregnancy, sex, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information, physical or mental disability, HIV status, registered domestic partner status, caregiver status, marital status, veteran or military status, citizenship status or any other legally protected category. If you have a need that requires accommodation, let us know by completing our&nbsp;<a href="https://www.collibra.com/us/en/company/careers/accommodations">Accommodations for Applicants form</a>.</p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/collibra-cps-account-program-manager">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/collibra-cps-account-program-manager</a></p>
</description>

      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0017/1267/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Ghent - Belgium
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://www.twikey.com/jobs">https://www.twikey.com/jobs</a>
</p>

<p>Are you a driven back-end developer who doesn't wait for instructions, but is already thinking two steps ahead? Who experiments with new technologies and smart solutions alongside the job? Then we want to talk to you.</p>
<p><strong>Straight forward but clear: Twikey isn't looking for someone to just execute. We're looking for someone who thinks, does and keeps going when the going gets tough.</strong></p>
<p>Because fintech is evolving at breakneck speed. That calls for real ownership and for someone who can dive deep on the technical side to keep innovating and improving our platform. You get plenty in return, such as the freedom and responsibility to deliver your own projects. Thanks in part to our organisational structure, you can shape your ideas in the short term and see the results of your hard work quickly.</p>
<p>Driven by your passion for building scalable, performant and secure back-end systems, you continuously raise the bar for your own skills and for our product.</p>
<p>As a member of our development team you work closely with our CTO, 3 fellow developers and 2 testers on the core of our software application. A small, strong team in which you take on a role with real impact on the future of our product.</p>
<ul>
<li>You focus on&nbsp;<strong>developing and improving the back-end</strong>&nbsp;of our platform, optimising the architecture and data processing while keeping the security and stability of our system in mind. This lets you put your technical skills to full use and come up with innovative solutions.</li>
<li>With your expertise you'll&nbsp;<strong>make valuable suggestions and streamline processes</strong>&nbsp;for all our stakeholders, so we can work more efficiently and achieve better results.</li>
<li>You provide&nbsp;<strong>technical support on integration projects</strong>&nbsp;with software houses, banks and large companies, solving complex technical problems. That gives you the chance to work on challenging projects and to get in touch with a wide range of technologies and industries.</li>
</ul>
<p>Once you know our product inside out, there are plenty of challenging projects for you to help build.</p>
<h4 class="sec-title-9">What are we looking for in you?</h4>
<ul>
<li>You are&nbsp;<strong>driven, curious and enterprising.</strong>&nbsp;Not only in your job, but outside of it too. You have a&nbsp;<strong>pro-active attitude</strong>&nbsp;and are always a few steps ahead: you spot opportunities, grab them and get to work.</li>
<li>Technical challenges? You take them on, not because you have to, but because you want to&nbsp;<strong>learn</strong>. You're a&nbsp;<strong>self-starter</strong>&nbsp;and quickly get to grips with new technologies, languages or frameworks.</li>
<li>You understand that a good product is never "finished". You draw energy from that&nbsp;<strong>mix of creating and fine-tuning</strong>. You think along, question things and keep building new solutions.</li>
<li>You have experience using AI tools to build integrations. You're&nbsp;<strong>actively exploring how AI can contribute</strong>&nbsp;to smarter user experiences and more efficient software development. Experience with data analytics is an asset.</li>
<li>You therefore attach&nbsp;<strong>a lot of importance to the security, stability and reliability</strong>&nbsp;of a system and know what it takes to get there. You work in a structured, meticulous way and write code that is clean, reusable and easy to test.</li>
<li>You have demonstrable experience with&nbsp;<strong>Java, Go and the Spring framework</strong>. Experience with API integrations, web services, Linux or other relevant areas is a plus.</li>
<li>You have&nbsp;<strong>a deep understanding of databases.</strong>&nbsp;You don't just know how to use them, you know how they work. You have an opinion on structured, high-quality code, architecture and back-end technologies.</li>
<li>You have a very good command of&nbsp;<strong>English</strong>, for smooth collaboration with all colleagues and stakeholders. Dutch is an asset.</li>
<li>You are based in a time zone within&nbsp;<strong>one hour of CET</strong>, so your working day overlaps with the team's for the daily stand-ups and close day-to-day collaboration.</li>
<li>You can work independently and enjoy a small team where switching gears quickly, collaboration and knowledge sharing are central.</li>
</ul>
<h4 class="sec-title-9">Twikey offers you:</h4>
<ul>
<li>An environment where challenge, innovation and autonomy come first.</li>
<li>The room to&nbsp;<strong>experiment, to challenge and to improve.</strong>&nbsp;And we expect you to really take that room.</li>
<li>An ideal setting if you want to grow fast and healthily, both technically and personally. Training, ownership, taking on new or additional roles based on your talents and interests, ... a lot is possible here, and you're at the wheel!</li>
<li>A&nbsp;<strong>complementary team of more than 35 colleagues</strong>&nbsp;who move forward together in a respectful and open atmosphere.</li>
<li>A motivating workplace with&nbsp;<strong>plenty of knowledge and expertise</strong>, shared both formally during the daily stand-ups and the weekly Friday call, and informally at the coffee machine.</li>
<li><strong>Appreciation, openness and critical dialogue.</strong>&nbsp;Our Friction Hunter Trophy is an example: every month we celebrate the colleague who made the biggest difference for customers, teammates or internally. Your impact gets noticed!</li>
<li>A modern workplace with different zones (conference, connect, co-work, concentrate) in a recently built, industrial-style office building. Easy to reach by car, by bike and by public transport on the edge of Ghent, right next to the KBC tower.</li>
<li>A&nbsp;<strong>salary package tailored</strong>&nbsp;to your experience and skills, with plenty of extra-legal benefits, a collective bonus system and a cafeteria plan to convert your 13th month as you choose.</li>
<li>The chance to work in an&nbsp;<strong>innovative Belgian fintech scale-up</strong>&nbsp;that is active in several countries, in a sector that is growing fast!</li>
</ul>
<p>A job ad doesn't tell you everything. Our colleagues tell you&nbsp;<a class="link" href="https://www.twikey.com/jobs/testimonials.html">here</a> what it's really like to work at Twikey.</p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/twikey-senior-java-developer">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/twikey-senior-java-developer</a></p>
</description>

<p>$135,000-$195,000, plus eligibility for an annual discretionary bonus, retirement plan, and PTO</p>
